name: dotcontent-api
description: The dotcontent backend, as a NestJS service. Shares lib/server with the repo root.

scripts.dev: cross-env TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=1 DOTCONTENT_DATA_DIR=../.data ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/main.ts
scripts.start:local: cross-env TS_NODE_BASEURL=./dist DOTCONTENT_DATA_DIR=../.data node -r tsconfig-paths/register dist/api/src/main.js
